records.title: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
records.reason: The inference result is a small adjunct to a training-focused report; accepted length is not end-to-end latency/QPS, and the drafter integration uses a specific setup. Relevance to inference efficiency is therefore weak.

records.title: Think Before You Link: Rarity, Reasoning, and Retrieval in Multilingual Entity Linking
records.reason: arXiv abstract addresses multilingual entity linking accuracy through reasoning and retrieval, not inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: Studying Without a Syllabus: Task-Agnostic Environment Preprocessing
records.reason: arXiv abstract studies an agent preparing environment artifacts before downstream tasks; it measures task preparation, not model inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: LLaDA-UI: Bringing Block-wise Diffusion to Vision-Language GUI Agents
records.reason: The central contribution is a trained GUI agent and benchmark capability result; the abstract’s efficiency motivation is not substantiated by a system-level speed measurement in the inspected evaluation.

records.title: I/O Lower-Bound Theory and Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Neural Network Inference Optimization
records.reason: The packet contains an abstract describing neural-network inference optimization, but the primary source URL https://doi.org/10.1145/3841638 returned an internal error when opened; no readable publisher full text was available in this screening run.
